episode_summary: In this episode, Kristy Nakamura shares her journey of building a successful real estate business by focusing on VA loans and military families. She emphasizes the importance of leveraging existing relationships over chasing new leads and discusses how AI tools can enhance real estate operations. Kristy also provides insights into multi-generational housing solutions and the strategic use of seller credits to make homes more affordable.
